question: Out of the following metals, choose the odd one out on the basis of their place in the periodic table.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Magnesium**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The odd one out is Magnesium. Lithium, sodium, and potassium are all alkali metals, which are characterized by having a single valence electron in their outermost shell. This gives them similar chemical properties, such as high reactivity and low electronegativity.
 
• Magnesium, on the other hand, is an alkaline earth metal, which means it has two valence electrons in its outermost shell. This makes it less reactive and more electronegative than the alkali metals.
